title: Gardiiɗo Damal Naange Fuɗnaange
intro: E nder Qur’aana fof, won e ruuhuuji ina njillondiri e leydi ina njillondiri e laabi hakkilantaagal e kaawis. Gooto e ɗeen limooje yahri ko to nokkuuji ɓurɗi woɗɗude e tagoore ndee – ɗo naange fuɗata e to mutta, ɗo barme jogori reende jiiɓru e hoore mum. Oo maccuɗo Alla rokkaama laamu ngu hay gooto jogoraani jogaade ɗum kadi. E nder njilluuji tati ceertuɗi, faandaare oo neɗɗo laaɓtii. Mbele aɗa waawi anndude ooɗoo ƴaañoowo legendaire e nder ɓuuɓri daartol ?
clues: Mi rokkaama mbaawka e juuɗe Joom yurmeende ngam laamaade leydi ndii e mbaadi ndi hay gooto meeɗaa heɓde.
Mi yahi haa hirnaange haa mi yottii nokku ɗo naange muti, tawi ina mutta e nder ɓuuɓol murtungol, mi seedtii leñol toon.
Mi yahdi fuɗnaange haa mi yetti nokku ɗo naange fuɗi ɗoo, tawi naange fuɗii e dow leñol ngol min ndokkaani ɗum ɓuuɓri.
Miɗo yahra hakkunde ɗeen toɓɓe ɗiɗi ɓurɗe toowde haa mi arti e falnde hakkunde koɗli ɗiɗi, tawi mi tawii leñol ngol waawataa faamde haala.
Mi tawi e dow tulde hee, 6oggi njamndi 6alee6e cficfi ina njahdi e nyaamo e nano, hakkunde majji, ko 6aleeri 6aleeri. Ɓeen yimɓe naamndii kam yo mi taƴtu barme jogaade jiiɓru.
Mi ƴettii ñamri am, mbi’mi: “So barme oo taƴii, ɗum wonata ko seerndude laaɓɗo hakkunde amen e ooɗoo leñol.” Kadi nde waktu toɗɗaaɗo oo yottii, miɗo ndaara no barme oo 6eydorii 6eydaade.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Taƴde njamndi mboɗeeri wonande yimɓe Yajuj e Majuj
Mahngo Laana e les yamiroore annabi
Taccude maayo woɗeewo e yimɓe goonɗinɓe
Mahngo baraas ngam reende leñol peewal
trial.answer: Taƴde njamndi mboɗeeri wonande yimɓe Yajuj e Majuj

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Barme oo taƴaa nde waktu toɗɗaaɗo oo yonti, jiiɓru yani
Heefeerɓe ɓee njippiima e ndiyam, gooŋɗinɓe ɓee kisnaama
Sanamuuji ɗii njuumtaama, yimɓe ɓee tuubnii
outcome.answer: Barme oo taƴaa nde waktu toɗɗaaɗo oo yonti, jiiɓru yani

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
